svg.title: Every known exoplanet with a distance, around the Sun
svg.desc: Every known exoplanet with a distance, around the Sun: 8,049 of the 8,376 planets in exoplanet.eu (fetched 2026-10-18), around 5,433 host stars, seen from above the Galactic plane with the Sun at the centre and the Galactic centre (longitude 0°) at the top. Angle is galactic longitude; distance from the centre is the listed distance on a logarithmic scale, with rings at 10, 100, 1,000 and 10,000 light-years; galactic latitude is dropped. Colour is the first detection method listed: Transit 4,790; Radial velocity 1,329; Imaging 1,216; Microlensing 356; Timing 181; Astrometry 89; Other (TTV, kinematic, other) 88. The 327 planets without a distance are not drawn. pi Men, host of pi Men c and the star of SetuHQ's stored run, is marked at 59.9 light-years. No Milky Way is drawn: every point is a catalogue position, not an illustration. Source: docs/results/exoplanet_map.json, commit befef30.
